title: sida acuta subsp. carpinifolia
intro: Sida acuta subsp. carpinifolia, commonly known as the prickly sida or prickly mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sida acuta subsp. carpinifolia include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic effects, which make it a potential natural remedy for managing pain, reducing fever, and preventing infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
